attchmntText: Finolex Cables Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Finolex Cables Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of 2,269 crore rupees for Q2 FY27, representing a 53 percent year-on-year increase. Consolidated profit after tax stood at 273 crore rupees, up 67.8 percent year-on-year. Earnings per share were 17.85 rupees. The electrical cables segment contributed 1,960 crore rupees in revenue. Communication cables revenue reached 230 crore rupees. The company highlighted strong industry tailwinds from infrastructure and renewable energy projects. Promoters hold 35.9 percent of the shareholding. The presentation was uploaded to the company website.

attchmntText: Finolex Cables Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Finolex Cables Limited disclosed that its Board of Directors approved an amendment to the Code of Conduct to regulate, monitor, and report trading by designated persons and their immediate relatives on November 07, 2026. The amended Code is effective from November 07, 2026. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 8(2) of the SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015. The document defines terms such as insiders, connected persons, and unpublished price sensitive information. It outlines applicability to directors, key managerial personnel, and employees with access to sensitive data. The code aims to prevent misuse of unpublished price sensitive information. The full amended code is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Finolex Cables Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Finolex Cables Limited Board approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Deloitte Haskins Sells LLP issued an unmodified Limited Review Report on 7th November 2026. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 2,259.33 crore rupees. Profit before tax was 88.67 crore rupees. Profit for the quarter was 51.49 crore rupees. Earnings per share was 0.61 rupees. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 4,282.48 crore rupees. Profit before tax was 140.16 crore rupees. Profit for the period was 109.81 crore rupees. Earnings per share was 1.06 rupees. The Board Meeting commenced at 11.30 am and concluded at 01.37 pm on 7th November 2026.
